context:
Pilot attempt 2 (claude.ai/code web session, BenchBox-dev/benchbox attached): first-minute checks PASSED (origin present, fetch develop at 8a64bcf5, dry-run push accepted). Builder stopped at make cloud-bootstrap per cloud-builder.md, no edits/commits. Blocker 1: node 22.22.0 in image; markdownlint hook needs ^22.22.2/^24.15.0/>=26. Blocker 2: tailscale/tailscaled not installed, so gateway=unavailable and make pr-open would refuse before push. Both are owner env prerequisites already listed in docs/agent/cloud-builder.md (Environment setup, Oracle gateway access). Session git identity was Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>; BENCHBOX_GIT_NAME/EMAIL are set so bootstrap should pin the human identity; builder must verify before commit. Setup time ~9 min incl clone. Next: owner updates the environment setup script (draft at /tmp/cloud-env-setup.sh, untested; needs network allowlist for nodejs.org, astral.sh, pkgs.tailscale.com), starts a NEW session, reruns same prompt. Claim retained.

Correction after reading code.claude.com/docs/en/cloud-environments: (1) setup scripts run as root BEFORE environment variables are set, so make cloud-bootstrap must NOT be in the setup script (it needs BENCHBOX_GIT_NAME/EMAIL); the builder runs it per cloud-builder.md. docs/agent/cloud-builder.md says to run bootstrap in the setup script and may need a docs correction. (2) uv and Node 20/21/22 are preinstalled (node22 = 22.22.0); nodejs.org is in the Trusted allowlist; pkgs.tailscale.com is not, so network access must be Custom with default list plus Tailscale hosts and build.stencil.so (OMP pin host). (3) Anthropic GitHub proxy rejects GraphQL (gh pr/issue subcommands 403); BenchBox make pr-open uses REST so should be OK, unverified. (4) Script must exit zero and finish under ~5 min to be cached. Revised draft at /tmp/cloud-env-setup.sh (untested): installs Node 24 + Tailscale only.

Pilot attempt 4: node blocker fixed (builder reports node v24.22.2). make cloud-bootstrap now refuses on uv: image has 0.11.32, pyproject.toml [tool.uv] required-version >=0.13.4. Builder stopped without edits. Setup ~14s to refusal. Fix: ~/cloud-env-setup.sh now installs uv>=0.13.4 from PyPI into /opt/uv-venv and links over the existing uv (untested). Tailscale install and gateway reachability not yet exercised. UV_NATIVE_TLS deprecation warning (use UV_SYSTEM_CERTS) is warning-only. docs/agent/cloud-builder.md Environment setup should also list the uv minimum.

Pilot attempt 5 (claude.ai web session): bootstrap passed 130s; implementation committed locally e5ea87350074044864c44bf8a7aedcf67670cf30 (NOT pushed; no branch on GitHub). Fix: return match.group(1), match.group(2); 2 tests added; ty diagnostic cleared; self-review 0 Critical/Required, 3 Nits. cloud-verify LEVEL=tests ~1945s: test-fast 4 failed/36513 passed; test-medium-selected 19 failed/16225 passed; builder classified all 23 as sandbox-only: no zstd binary (2); proxy defeats network guard (2: urlopen, build_opener); shallow clone missing commits like 68fb5a071^ (8 canary impact cases); root ignores chmod/readonly (3: test_error_handling x2, worktree lock dir); BENCHBOX_EPHEMERAL_CLONE=1 breaks 2 test_agent_write_preflight tests (fail same on base); 'Entering directory' make noise (3 test_make_timing + 1 worktree create); DuckDB delta extension download (1); todo-db bootstrap offline (1). Blocker: make pr-open local oracle review unavailable, all 5 slots (medium x2, large x2, huge) exit code 1 with no reason, twice; gateway healthz=200 models=200 via 127.0.0.1:1055; pinned omp passes check. Builder correctly did not push by hand. Env bug: BENCHBOX_GIT_NAME contains curly quote (Joe Harris”); bootstrap pinned it in .git/config; builder committed with git -c user.name override. Timings: setup ~3min, impl ~1min, verify ~32min, pr-open attempts ~15min; cost unknown. Next: read-only diagnosis of omp exit 1 (~/cloud-pilot-1-diagnose.md sent to builder), then rerun pr-open.

Diagnosis of pr-open local oracle review failure (builder, read-only): all 10 slot attempts (2 pr-open runs x 5) fail with getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND <gateway-host> from provider anthropic; omp 18.13.3 does its own DNS for the pi-native gateway call and does not use HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:1055 passed by commands.omp_env. cloud-gateway/pr-open health checks go through the proxy so they pass. Hand reproduction with the reviewer's own builders gives the same exit 1, stderr empty. Env wiring: slots get PATH, HOME, TMPDIR, SHELL, OMP_GATEWAY_TOKEN, HTTPS_PROXY, HTTP_PROXY, NO_PROXY only; root user, HOME writable. omp docs (environment-variables.md Outbound proxy routing) list PI_PROXY_<PROVIDER>, PI_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY/https_proxy, ALL_PROXY; experiment A-E sent (~/cloud-pilot-1-proxy-test.md) to find which one the pi-native call honors. Fix candidate: set that variable in _project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/commands.py omp_env when _gateway_proxy is set (separate PR, soundness path status to check). Cloud-builder.md claims the gateway is verified on Claude Code on the web; this shows the omp model call never completed through the proxy there. Separate defects: saved capture files under ~/.cache/benchbox/local-oracle/captures record the gateway hostname unredacted in terminal_error.message; builder printed a 60-char ORACLE_GATEWAY_URL prefix to chat once (no token) - treat the host as exposed in session transcript.

Builder retest confirmed: after make cloud-gateway restart, PI_PROXY and PI_PROXY_ANTHROPIC both fix omp (exit 0, 3.9-6.1s); all 3 reviewer selectors answer (@default claude-sonnet-5-5 4.8s, @review claude-opus-5-5 3.5s, @plan claude-opus-5-5 3.5s). Only PI_PROXY* work; HTTPS_PROXY/https_proxy/ALL_PROXY ignored by omp 18.13.3. Container restart earlier killed tailscaled; gateway status file stayed gateway=reachable (stale). Raw-host captures deleted by builder. Fix PR #3900 (fix/oracle-omp-pi-proxy, head 8ba7718639) opened 2026-10-31: omp_env sets PI_PROXY from validated loopback proxy; 2183 oracle_reviewers tests pass; soundness path => arm only on oracle success review of current head. Primary-clone guard was blocked briefly by an uncommitted edit to docs/internal/dev-loop-worktrees.md that was gone by stash time (stash found nothing; owner authorized stash). Next: oracle review + merge #3900; builder pulls develop into its branch (rebase local commit e5ea87350 onto develop with the fix), reruns make cloud-gateway, then make pr-open. Builder commit e5ea87350 still unpushed. BENCHBOX_GIT_NAME curly-quote env fix still pending from owner.
description: The repository's type checker reports invalid-return-type in _resolved_git_identity at _project/scripts/agent_instruction_audit.py: the function promises tuple[str, str], while re.Match.groups() is inferred as a variadic tuple containing optional strings. The warning reproduces on origin/develop and was not introduced by the anchor-whitespace change. Log it separately rather than hiding it in an unrelated PR.

preserves.behavior: Do not weaken agent/service identity detection or change Git config precedence and failure behavior.

work_units.summary: Narrow _resolved_git_identity to return exactly two strings without suppressing the type checker
Cover successful Git identity parsing, command failure, and malformed output
